labelChirho: Zebedee (proper noun, father of James and John)
descriptionChirho: Proper noun referring to Zebedaios (Zebedee), the father of the apostles James and John, a Galilean fisherman. Both sense clusters refer to the same individual — the split was merely due to different transliteration patterns and syntactic contexts (genitive 'of Zebedee' vs. standalone name). Multilingual evidence: Spanish 'de–Zebedaîos/Zebedaîos/Zebedaíou' (all forms of the same name), Hindi 'ज़बदी/जब्दी/जबदी' (Zabdī, variant transliterations), Arabic 'زَبَدِي/زَبَدَى' (Zabadī/Zabadā), Korean '세베대–의/세베대의–아들' (Sebedae, with possessive markers), Swahili 'wa–Zebedaiós/Zebedaîos/Zebedaíos' (of Zebedaios). All 12 occurrences reference the same historical person without any semantic variation.
